package {{BASE_PACKAGE}}.{{feature}};

import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.core.scheduler.Schedulers;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/{{resource-path}}")
class {{FeatureName}}Controller {
    private final {{FeatureName}}Service service;

    {{FeatureName}}Controller({{FeatureName}}Service service) {
        this.service = service;
    }

    @PostMapping
    Mono<ResponseEntity<{{FeatureName}}Response>> create(
            @Valid @RequestBody {{FeatureName}}CreateRequest request) {
        return service.create(request)
                .map(response -> ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(response));
    }
}

@Service
class {{FeatureName}}Service {
    private final {{FeatureName}}Validator validator;
    private final {{FeatureName}}Mapper mapper;
    private final {{FeatureName}}Repository repository;

    {{FeatureName}}Service(
            {{FeatureName}}Validator validator,
            {{FeatureName}}Mapper mapper,
            {{FeatureName}}Repository repository) {
        this.validator = validator;
        this.mapper = mapper;
        this.repository = repository;
    }

    Mono<{{FeatureName}}Response> create({{FeatureName}}CreateRequest request) {
        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
            validator.validateCreate(request);
            {{FeatureName}}Entity entity = mapper.toEntity(request);
            {{FeatureName}}Entity saved = repository.save(entity);
            return mapper.toResponse(saved);
        }).subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic());
    }
}

interface {{FeatureName}}Repository {
    {{FeatureName}}Entity save({{FeatureName}}Entity entity);
}

@Component
class {{FeatureName}}Mapper {
    {{FeatureName}}Entity toEntity({{FeatureName}}CreateRequest request) {
        return new {{FeatureName}}Entity(null, request.name());
    }

    {{FeatureName}}Response toResponse({{FeatureName}}Entity entity) {
        return new {{FeatureName}}Response(entity.id(), entity.name());
    }
}

@Component
class {{FeatureName}}Validator {
    void validateCreate({{FeatureName}}CreateRequest request) {
        // Add only custom validation that cannot be expressed clearly with annotations.
    }
}

        @NotBlank String name
) {
}

        String name

}
